note: Hand-computed from C-03, C-04 and C-06 in 22-CONTEXT.md; never generated by the code under test. Shared by the renderer (ic-render-2.0.0) and the Python digest. Meta is the render-form tile measure {column, kind, parts, formula}; rows are daily rows keyed metric_time__day; as_of is the as-of day in the tile's zone; horizon_start is today - horizon_days + 1; today defaults to 2026-11-04. expect is a number, null, or {na: custom|range|nodata}. A missing day inside [horizon_start, as_of] counts 0 for sum, every part and distinct. members: expect.members lists [member, value] in order (Other last), expect.other the Other value or null, expect.dropped how many members are not shown. totals: rows_are buckets gives the range value over the whole range, members combines every member; distinct, now and fixed give null (an en dash). as_of before the range end (data lags today): the comparison range is cut by the same number of days as the current range, so both sides cover the same elapsed days; count-distinct presets rows are server-computed and are not cut.
